name: com.stylovich.hdrp-tonemapper
description: SDR tonemappers for the High Definition Render Pipeline, as custom post processes: a port of AMD FidelityFX LPM (Luma Preserving Mapper) and AgX (Blender 4.x, Rec.2020) with its Punchy / Golden looks. Both replace HDRP's Tonemapping (set it to None).

samples.description: Volume profiles with HDRP's Tonemapping set to None and either FidelityFX LPM or AgX enabled.
